g.text: 2 · BUILD, ONE CHUNK AT A TIME
a risk class and a proof
STATIC GATE · scripts decide, no model, no tokens · runs before any reviewer
FAILS THE GATE: one red step and the chunk goes back, no reviewer yet
FLAGS, NEVER FAILS: a reviewer judges each one, what stays goes on your report
A skipped step is printed as skipped, never counted as a pass.
A step that could not run fails the gate.
Revert check runs only when the chunk changed tests and source.
Not in the gate: credentials (your CI); suppressions, `as any`
and complexity (your ESLint config, through the lint step).
the chunk report and the diff:
low risk: no reviewer, no verifier, straight to you
BACK TO THE IMPLEMENTER with the output · 2 static rounds, then 3 or 5 fix rounds at most
guard.sh HOOK, on every tool call · git is read-only · no PR · no package the registry does not vouch for · reviewer and verifier cannot write
